The field is `me_maxreaders`. The corpus confirms it in `mdb_env_set_maxreaders()` (`lmdb/libraries/liblmdb/mdb.c:5227`), which stores the caller-supplied reader-slot maximum directly into `env->me_maxreaders` — the same field read back by `mdb_env_get_maxreaders()` (declared in `lmdb/libraries/liblmdb/lmdb.h:1033`). (Distinct from `me_numreaders`, which tracks the current number of readers in use.)

ANSWER: `me_maxreaders`
